Determine whether the following statement is true, false, or unknown:
The bear visits the mouse.

Predicates:
Eats($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x eat y?
Cold($x, bool) ::: Is x cold?
Likes($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x like y?
Visits($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x visit y?
Blue($x, bool) ::: Is x blue?
Kind($x, bool) ::: Is x kind?
Big($x, bool) ::: Is x big?

Facts:
Eats(BaldEagle, Bear, True) ::: The bald eagle eats the bear.
Cold(BaldEagle, True) ::: The bald eagle is cold.
Likes(BaldEagle, Bear, False) ::: The bald eagle does not like the bear.
Likes(BaldEagle, Tiger, True) ::: The bald eagle likes the tiger.
Visits(BaldEagle, Bear, True) ::: The bald eagle visits the bear.
Eats(Bear, BaldEagle, True) ::: The bear eats the bald eagle.
Blue(Bear, True) ::: The bear is blue.
Visits(Bear, Tiger, False) ::: The bear does not visit the tiger.
Likes(Mouse, Tiger, True) ::: The mouse likes the tiger.
Eats(Tiger, Mouse, True) ::: The tiger eats the mouse.
Cold(Tiger, True) ::: The tiger is cold.
Likes(Tiger, Bear, True) ::: The tiger likes the bear.

Rules:
Kind(Mouse, True) >>> Eats(Mouse, BaldEagle, True) ::: If the mouse is kind then the mouse eats the bald eagle.
Eats($x, BaldEagle, True) && Likes(BaldEagle, Tiger, True) >>> Likes(Tiger, Mouse, True) ::: If something eats the bald eagle and the bald eagle likes the tiger then the tiger likes the mouse.
Likes($x, Tiger, True) >>> Visits($x, Mouse, True) ::: If something likes the tiger then it visits the mouse.
Likes(Tiger, Mouse, True) && Eats(Mouse, Tiger, False) >>> Big(Mouse, True) ::: If the tiger likes the mouse and the mouse does not eat the tiger then the mouse is big.
Visits($x, Bear, True) && Kind($x, True) >>> Likes(Bear, Tiger, True) ::: If something visits the bear and it is kind then the bear likes the tiger.
Cold($x, True) && Kind($x, True) >>> Big($x, True) ::: Cold, kind things are big.
Eats(Tiger, BaldEagle, True) >>> Eats(Tiger, Mouse, False) ::: If the tiger eats the bald eagle then the tiger does not eat the mouse.
Visits($x, Mouse, True) >>> Kind($x, True) ::: If something visits the mouse then it is kind.
Eats(BaldEagle, Mouse, True) && Eats(Mouse, Bear, False) >>> Big(BaldEagle, True) ::: If the bald eagle eats the mouse and the mouse does not eat the bear then the bald eagle is big.

Query:
Visits(Bear, Mouse, True) ::: The bear visits the mouse.
